grpc._comment: Code-first gRPC over grpc-web. The path segment after /gRPC/ is the contract interface's full name, so every service contract must live under the GSBC.Accounting.Shared.Contracts namespace for this to match.

api._comment: Attachment upload and download, and the PDF render. These are plain HTTP minimal APIs rather than gRPC because the gRPC channel must never carry file bytes - a receipt is 1-20 MB. No policy HERE, deliberately: the proxy holds no database connection and cannot check the __gsbc_anon cookie, so the gRPC service authorises these itself - writes behind the AnonymousSession policy, reads open by id for a submitted claim. It forwards the Cookie header and carries a sealed envelope it cannot open. The rate limits and size caps live there too.

wasm._comment: Catch-all, and it must stay last - it serves index.html for every unmatched path, which is what makes client-side routing work.
